    Model life tables including both sexes

    modelLTx1_both.Rd

    Female and male model life tables from DemoToolsData, with both-sex tables constructed using a sex ratio at birth of 1.04 males per female. Both-sex survivorship, deaths, and person-years are birth-weighted before deriving mortality rates and life expectancy.

    modelLTx1_both

    Format

    A data frame with 16 columns:

    source, family, type_mlt

    Model life table source and family.

    sex

    Sex: female, male, or both.

    e0

    Model life expectancy level used to pair female and male tables.

    age

    Exact age at the start of each interval.

    mx1, qx1, lx1, dx1, Lx1, Tx1, sx1, ex1, ax1

    Original life table columns, with the source radix retained in count and person-year columns.

    lx

    Survivorship normalized to 1 at birth within each table.

    Source

    DemoToolsData::modelLTx1; both-sex tables derived with SRB 1.04.
